title: तुम्हारे assignment के पाँचों references नकली निकले
experiment: E2 Funny: a comedy skit with the cast; Chintu the monkey plays the AI that confidently makes up references, and the trick (search the title on Google Scholar in quotes) is the punchline. Pass mark: shares per 1,000 views 8 or more.
look: illustrated story, my face and body (hoodie), Prof. Sharma as the professor, Chintu as the AI, compact captions
style: Natural conversational Hindi as spoken in India, like a friend who tells you a funny short story and then lets you in on a useful trick. English words in Indian English. Confident, clear and brisk, one even tone for the whole story, with only a short breath between sentences. No acting, no exaggeration.
sources: https://scholar.google.com/intl/en/scholar/help.html#searching (captured 2026-10-20): 'How do I search by title? Put the paper's title in quotations: "A History of the China Sea".'

https://scholar.google.com/intl/en/scholar/help.html#export (captured 2026-10-20): 'How can I add the full citation of a result on Google Scholar to my bibliography manager?' 'Click the "Cite" button under the search result and then select your bibliography manager at the bottom of the popup.'
https://scholar.google.com/ showed a bot check to the capture, so the search page itself is not shown; the search is acted out on a drawn laptop with a plain search box.
claims: AI chatbots can give references that do not exist: widely reported (for example the 2023 US court case Mata v. Avianca, where a lawyer filed invented cases from ChatGPT). The reel names no chatbot.
Search a title in quotes on Google Scholar: the help page says so.
A Cite button under a result gives the full citation: the help page says so.
Story, not data: the five fake books and their titles are drawn jokes, not claims.
Not claimed: that Scholar finds every real book, or which citation styles the popup shows.

sentences: तुम्हारे assignment के पाँचों references नकली निकले।
और Sharma Sir ने एक-एक करके पकड़ लिए।
कल रात तुमने AI से बोला, पाँच references दे दो।
दस second में title, author और साल, सब हाज़िर।
पर उनमें से एक भी किताब असल में है ही नहीं।
AI को जब पता नहीं होता, तो वो सच जैसा कुछ बना देता है।
इसलिए submit से पहले हर title Google Scholar पर quotes में डालकर search करो।
ऐसे और AI जुगाड़ के लिए follow कर लो।
जो असली निकले, उसके नीचे Cite दबाओ, और पूरा reference बना-बनाया मिलेगा।
अगले assignment पर Sharma Sir ने references पढ़े।
और बस इतना बोले कि very good।
Comment में कुछ भी लिख दो।
Assignment वाले group में यह भेज दो।
